transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ConversalQ support, this is Jamie. How can I assist you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I want to cancel my subscription and get a refund for this month. I barely used the service.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand. I'm sorry to hear you want to cancel. May I ask what prompted this decision? Was there something we could have done better?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Honestly the product is fine, I just don't have the budget right now. I signed up 4 days ago.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for letting me know. Since you subscribed less than 7 days ago, you're within our full refund window. I can process both the cancellation and a full refund of $99 right now.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Oh really? I didn't know you had that policy. That's good to know.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, we have a 7-day money-back guarantee. I've cancelled your subscription effective immediately and submitted the refund. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Perfect. And if my budget situation changes, can I come back?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Absolutely! Your account data will be retained for 90 days, so reactivating is easy. We'd love to have you back.
